title: U.S. Coast Guard searching for missing Hamilton-based air ambulance with 6 passengers
summary: The U.S. Coast Guard is searching for a Hamilton-based air ambulance aircraft that has gone missing with six people on board while flying from Bermuda to Boston early Saturday morning.

image.caption: A file photo of a CBC News breaking news logo. (CBC)

blocks.text: The U.S. Coast Guard is searching for a Hamilton-based air ambulance aircraft that has gone missing with six people on board while flying from Bermuda to Boston early Saturday morning.
Aircraft went missing while travelling from Bermuda to Boston early Saturday morning
Aircraft C-GRJP is registered to Latitude Air Ambulance, a Hamilton-based air ambulance provider, according to the website Flightradar24.
